set100.word: Which word is closest in meaning (a synonym-type match) to the idea: "A tightrope walker"?

set101.word: Which word is closest in meaning (a synonym-type match) to the idea: "A person who talks in their sleep"?

set101.word: Which word means: "A person who eats meat"?
explanation: Carnitarian - A person who eats meat (मांसाहारी व्यक्ति) - Correct

set101.word: Which word is closest in meaning (a synonym-type match) to the idea: "Government by the people, usually through elected representatives"?

set101.word: Which word means: "A flexible, informal system of organisation without fixed rules"?

set101.word: Which word is closest in meaning (a synonym-type match) to the idea: "A person who practises marriage to only one spouse"?

set101.word: Which word is closest in meaning (a synonym-type match) to the idea: "A person who is between 60 and 69 years old"?

set102.word: Which word means: "Happening every five years"?

set102.word: Which word is closest in meaning (a synonym-type match) to the idea: "A soft, gentle neigh of a horse"?

set102.word: Which word means: "A high-pitched complaining cry, as of a dog"?

set103.word: Which word is closest in meaning (a synonym-type match) to the idea: "A low, threatening sound made by an animal"?

set103.word: Which word is closest in meaning (a synonym-type match) to the idea: "A conversation or dramatic scene between two people"?

set103.word: Which word means the OPPOSITE of the idea of 'Fear / Cowardice' — i.e. "Recklessly bold; taking unnecessary risks"?

set103.word: Which word means the OPPOSITE of the idea of 'Courage / Boldness' — i.e. "To shake or tremble, esp. from fear"?

set103.word: Which word is closest in meaning (a synonym-type match) to the idea: "To laugh lightly in a nervous or silly manner"?

Chivalrous - Courteous and honourable, esp. towards the weak (शूरवीर)

set104.word: Which word means: "Filled with horror or dismay"?

set104.word: Which word means: "A reckless or daring adventure"?

Aghast - Filled with shock or horror (भौचक्का)

set104.word: Which word is closest in meaning (a synonym-type match) to the idea: "A feeling of deep anxiety or dread"?

set104.word: Which word means the OPPOSITE of the idea of 'Calm / Peace' — i.e. "Extremely angry"?

set104.word: Which word means the OPPOSITE of the idea of 'Anger / Irritation' — i.e. "Extremely happy, peaceful and picturesque"?

set104.word: Which word means the OPPOSITE of the idea of 'Calm / Peace' — i.e. "Angry and bitter in tone"?

set104.word: Which word means the OPPOSITE of the idea of 'Anger / Irritation' — i.e. "A soothing song sung to help a child sleep"?
explanation: Hypothermia - Abnormally low body temperature (शरीर का तापमान कम होना)

set104.word: Which word is closest in meaning (a synonym-type match) to the idea: "Irritable and quarrelsome"?

set104.word: Which word means: "To persuade gently and patiently"?

set105.word: Which word means: "To become annoyed or impatient"?

set105.word: Which word is closest in meaning (a synonym-type match) to the idea: "A feeling of irritation or resentment"?

set105.word: Which word means: "To soothe someone's anger"?

set105.word: Which word is closest in meaning (a synonym-type match) to the idea: "Causing annoyance or worry; annoyed"?

Grumpy - Bad-tempered and disgruntled (चिड़चिड़ा)

set105.word: Which word means: "To put an end to or suppress"?

set105.word: Which word is closest in meaning (a synonym-type match) to the idea: "To cause a large amount of damage or harm"?

set105.word: Which word means the OPPOSITE of the idea of 'Happiness / Joy' — i.e. "Feeling or expressing great sorrow"?

Dolorous - Feeling or expressing great sorrow (दुखदायी) - Correct
